name: cowork-projects
description: GitHub-backed project memory for Cowork. Keep every project's decisions, notes, and open questions in YOUR OWN GitHub repo: a /project hub, project-open with a table dashboard, one combined update command (upd) for memory + notes, new-project scaffolding with built-in legacy-chat import, active/archived lists, archive/unarchive, and a one-time /project-setup-init bootstrap of any repo you choose. GitHub is the source of truth; Google Drive optionally holds rich deliverables.
